name: connected-campaign-workspace
query: Set up our marketing workspace in Notion from these campaign notes. Use a new private workspace; don't search existing company information.

context.conversation: Fictional Northline campaign: Get Friday back, launches November 12, 2026. Lightweight invoicing for independent architects: unpaid-invoice visibility and editable reminder drafts, not automated collection. Candid, practical voice; deep blue. Article in review, planned Nov 12, approval pending. 45-second walkthrough in production for Nov 12, storyboard unpaid list > select invoice > edit reminder; no final video. Customer email drafting for Nov 13, consented existing customers only. LinkedIn idea undated/unapproved. Partner blurb blocked on confirmation, undated. Reminder how-to not started, proposed Nov 17. No assets, named owners, budgets, or performance supplied.

success_criteria: Creates a durable private marketing home with recognizable sidebar destinations, not a showcase under a comparison/demo parent.
Campaign is a record in a Campaigns collection even with one initial campaign; content uses native campaign relations and correctly filtered campaign views.
The home is an orientation surface; shared production, campaign context, and working drafts have distinct reachable destinations.
Visible campaign and content page properties convey lifecycle, dates, format, and relationships without repeating them as body text; unavailable layout controls are reported honestly.
All six deliverables are preserved, including undated and blocked work, and proposed dates/approval states remain truthful.
At least article, video, and email pages contain useful proposed work in format-specific bodies; no identical generic brief shells or fabricated assets.
Rendered review covers sidebar, home, campaign, and two different-format records; assesses density, clipping, hierarchy and navigation instead of treating Markdown readback as visual verification.
Skill output is assessed before manual changes; deficiencies trigger skill revision and a new clean run, not parent-agent polishing presented as a skill pass.
No publishing, email sending, sharing changes, unrelated searches, or school workspace edits.
